meta.description: Queue executor crew: enumerate any tracker/file queue, one lane per item with resume-from-disk, independent re-run verify, honest tally, owner's done contract.

work_queue.desc: where open items live: a JSON file path ({items:[{id,title,work}]}), a read-only command, or a URL

executor_rule.desc: standing rules every lane follows, verbatim (safety rails, output conventions, what NOT to touch)

done_contract.desc: how a finished item is marked: a command template containing {id}, a tracker note convention, or 'none' (report only)

graph.name: queue-executor
graph.description: Fan-out execution over an enumerated queue with independent verification and an honest tally.

nodes.goal: Enumerate the OPEN items in the work queue: {run.work_queue}. If it names a file, read it; if a command, run it read-only; if a URL, fetch it. Reduce each open item to exactly {id, title, work}: id = the queue's own stable identifier, title = one line, work = the COMPLETE instructions for that item copied faithfully (do not summarize away constraints). Skip items already closed or in flight from a prior run (their done-contract marks them). Return every open item, not a sample.

fanout.goal: Execute exactly ONE work item. Rails (standing rules, verbatim): {run.executor_rule}. Item {item.id} -- {item.title}. Complete instructions: {item.work}. Return status done/partial/blocked, the actions you took (measured numbers only), and receipt lines suitable for a ledger. Your schema `id` must be the literal item id: {item.id}

nodes.goal: Independent verification: for every lane result in Inputs claiming done, RE-RUN its own read-back (re-stat the file, re-count, re-grep, re-run the check command) — never accept a lane's self-report as proof. For partial/blocked, confirm the stated blocker is real and not a transient. List verified_ok (one line per proven item naming the proof you personally observed) and discrepancies (claim vs what you found).

Final tally and closing. An item counts DONE only if done AND present in verify.verified_ok. For each such item apply the owner's done contract: {run.done_contract} — substitute {id}; when the contract is 'none', just report. Discrepancies contradicting a lane claim must appear in the notes, never papered over. Output the honest totals against intake.queue_total: done / partial / blocked, and NAME anything missing or unverifiable.

defaults.context: You are one lane of a queue executor. Ground rules: the item's own work text outranks your initiative; resume-from-disk — before acting, check the queue or ledger for prior-run state and continue from disk truth, never restart finished steps; anything you launch that could outlive your turn must be detached so a pipe death cannot kill it; every claim you return comes from bytes you actually read or commands you actually ran, with measured numbers; report partial/blocked honestly — a false done is the only real failure.
